top_signals.title: India Oil Refiners Shift Tactics, Hire Ships to Cross Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Indian oil refiners are hiring tankers to sail through the Strait of Hormuz to pick up crude from within the Persian Gulf, a change of tactics to help them cut costs and secure their supply chains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Airtel Money Plans UK IPO Set to Be Biggest in Five Years
top_signals.summary: Mobile payments firm Airtel Money is looking to raise £529 million ($700 million) for its shareholders in what could be London’s biggest initial public offering in five years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: The incident in August caused the deaths of four workers during weeding operations at a station.
